clips.title: The story
paras: In Southshore, Loremaster Dibbs sends you to recover books from the Ruins of Alterac. Ogres have settled among the precious volumes left there, and one worn leather book matters most: it holds The Arm of Gri'lek, a work of ancient troll lore.

Loremaster Dibbs fears for the books in the Ruins of Alterac, where ogres have made their home. You are to search for the tomes they have looted and recover what you can. Dibbs would climb into the mountains to search as well, but fears old bones would not survive the journey.

Among the tomes, Loremaster Dibbs most wants a worn leather book containing The Arm of Gri'lek. Dibbs is bent on learning the ancient troll lore inside, and the Ruins of Alterac were the last known home of an intact copy.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Those beastly ogres now reside within Alterac's ruins, and I shudder to think what they're doing with the precious books still there. You must recover what you can!

Enter the Ruins of Alterac and search for tomes looted by the ogres. Get whatever you can find and bring them to me, but also seek out one book in particular: The Arm of Gri'lek. It contains ancient troll lore that I must learn, and the Ruins of Alterac was the last known location of an intact copy of this book.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I wish I could search the ruins too, but I fear these bones wouldn't hold me during my climb up the mountains. However, how does your hunt for knowledge progress, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, you got them! Splendid! I must begin studying the Arm of Gri'lek immediately!
